dialogue: Find me fully cooked, freeze dried, shelf stable, ready eat fresh meal kits with size: 1 pack, and price lower than 80.00 dollars
Freeze-dried isn't required if it's fully cooked and shelf-stable. And prefer multiple packs.
Prefer one with a self-heater or flameless heater.
Preferably a chicken or beef entree. Microwave heating is okay.
agent_final_statement: The selected 6-pack chicken chow mein is fully cooked, shelf-stable, ready to eat, microwave-heatable, and listed at $12.99, satisfying the core requirements and preferred multiple-pack chicken format.
